observed.note: The eight per-seed ratios reproduce this ARCH's own predecessor artifacts (2026-09-02-446-arch-set-5f281d8-h100-hbm3.json, 2026-08-28-m3-arch-set-80a451a-h100-hbm3.json) DIGIT-FOR-DIGIT — the per-arch flash-arm regression anchor is unchanged by this campaign's two bound fixes, measured rather than argued. The ratio set is arch-DEPENDENT (all four devices produce different numbers, each stable across three artifact generations), which is exactly why it is a per-arch producer and not a shared one. Checkpoint model.safetensors sha256 44510fec5d3a81a1877f225637b869495f18e55f6f23a09abb9be0acc030295f, verified on the pod before any GPU time was spent (matches the digest docs/maintainer/pod-build-guide.md Runbook C pins).

softmax_parity_f16_row_length_regimes.was: RED at 5f281d81 on sm_80/86/89/90, byte-identically: `softmax f16 dscores[35]: cpu -0.0010614395 vs cuda -0.0010671616 (bound 1.9073486e-6)` at last=257, rows=2 (n=514). The loop aborted there, so 513/1024/4096 had NEVER been evaluated on any arch.
softmax_parity_f16_row_length_regimes.now: GREEN at 7567b255 on this arch, with all six regimes evaluated. The per-length worst delta/bound values below are BYTE-IDENTICAL on all four devices measured in this unit (sm_80/86/89/90) — which is the substantive finding, not a restatement: the divergence 721bfef4 root-caused is a FOLD-ORDER property of `softmax_fwd_f16`'s 256-way strided partial versus `softmax_row_f16`'s sequential ascending fold, so it is a property of the source, not of the SASS any one arch compiles to, and an arch-VARYING result here would have falsified that account. Hopper is the strongest test of that claim in the set — a different SM generation, a different scheduler, and still bit-identical ratios.
softmax_parity_f16_row_length_regimes.forced_defect_note: Twelve forced-defect controls (fwd + dscores at each of the six lengths), every one firing, worst ratio ranging 8.744e3 to 2.97728e5 — so the green path above is NON-VACUOUS: the same bound that admits the measured delta rejects a real semantic mutant by four to five orders of magnitude. Byte-identical on all four arches.
softmax_parity_f16_row_length_regimes.first_ever_lengths: 513/1024/4096 are FIRST-EVER measurements on sm_90 — the pre-fix loop aborted at 257 and never reached them.

geglu_16bit_fwd_k_equals_3.was: worst delta/bound EXACTLY 1.0 at n_out=1024 — zero headroom, the only bound in either kernels leg sitting on its own worst case.
geglu_16bit_fwd_k_equals_3.note: 37653d41 derived k from the rounding STRUCTURE (3), not the rounding-point count (2): ROUND 1's activation cast sits UPSTREAM of the multiply, so its <=1 f16 ULP flip rides `act*up` into `out`. Headroom at n_out=1024 is now 1.5x BY CONSTRUCTION — a worst-case-derived bound against a near-worst-case sample, not a kernel defect. These ratios too are byte-identical on all four arches.

note: Campaign #446 unit W3-C, the final real-device round before the freeze: fresh per-arch validation for compute_cap 9.0 at the campaign branch tip. Supersedes this arch's 5f281d81 RED artifact, whose only red leg was `softmax_parity_f16_row_length_regimes`. Every leg is GREEN and every leg ran at the SAME sha (7567b255), on a first-choice SECURE NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 with no SUPPLY_CONSTRAINT and no fallback. Git-LFS: `git lfs pull --include='crates/jammi-kernels/tests/fixtures/**'` was run in the source worktree BEFORE the push and verified with `git lfs ls-files` (all 224 flash_reference *.npy listed as materialized, `*` not `-`; b1_s512_q.npy is 1048704 bytes on the pod, not a ~130-byte pointer). Without it flash_torch_parity/flash_torch_parity_f16 fail CLOSED on the pointer bytes — so their seven green tests here are evidence about the fixtures, not about a skipped suite. PROVENANCE: git_sha 7567b255 is the tip of fix/446-v049-blocker that these legs actually ran on — the pod tree was rsynced from a CLEAN worktree at that commit (the pod-side push stamp records laptop_head=7567b255655029d0cc90e77bcf9d878f055a43c5 with empty porcelain and empty diff-HEAD digests, so JAMMI_BUILD_SHA resolved rather than baking "unknown"), and `git merge-base --is-ancestor 7567b255 fix/446-v049-blocker` holds. The train PR must land as a MERGE COMMIT for this git_sha to become an ancestor of main's HEAD.
